newsitem.title: USA: Lucent, UAL say in talks as Olympics sponsor.
newsitem.headline: Lucent, UAL say in talks as Olympics sponsor.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said Tuesday it was in talks to be a U.S. Olympics Committee (USOC) sponsor through the 2004 games.
Also, UAL Corp said it was in talks with the USOC on being a sponsor but had not yet begun talks with NBC.
"We have not signed anything. We are in talks with our friends at the USOC," said Pete de Tagyos, event marketing vice president at Lucent. "It would be through the 2004 games."
De Tagyos said Lucent has not yet begun negotiations to be an advertiser with General Electric Co's NBC unit, which has broadcast rights through the 2008 games.
A UAL spokeswoman did not have other details.
NBC and the USOC have been reported to have sealed a major deal with General Motors Corp as sole automotive sponsor.
Also, Xerox Corp said it was in talks on an Olympics sponsorship, but provided no other details.
Home Depot Inc said it was considering a sponsorship, but a spokesman declined to say whether talks were underway with the USOC.
One source close to Home Depot said the retailer has been talking to USOC officials about a full six-games sponsorship package.
